gloss: parts cost; cost of replacement parts

definitions.gloss: parts cost; price of parts; cost of replacement components
definitions.explanation: The cost charged for physical parts or components, as distinct from labor charges. Commonly encountered when getting repairs done on cars, electronics, appliances, and other equipment.

examples.japanese: {部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧⟦かかります→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
examples.english: The parts cost is charged separately.

examples.japanese: ⟦{修理|しゅうり}→修理：03214_shuuri⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見積|みつも}もり⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}くて→高い：00500_takai⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by the high parts cost in the repair estimate.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工賃|こうちん}→工賃：23036_kouchin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{三千円|さんぜんえん}だ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、{部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}める→含める：02408_fukumeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{一万円|いちまんえん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The labor charge is 3,000 yen, but including parts it exceeds 10,000 yen.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{部品|ぶひん}→部品：00020_buhin⟧ (parts, components) + ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ (cost, charge). The suffix ⟦{代|だい}→〜代：28331_dai⟧ is one of the most common ways to express cost in Japanese, attaching to many nouns: {食事代|しょくじだい} (meal cost), ⟦{交通費|こうつうひ}→交通費：03056_koutsuuhi⟧ (transport cost), ⟦{電気代|でんきだい}→電気代：09543_denkidai⟧ (electricity bill).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{工賃|こうちん}→工賃：23036_kouchin⟧: parts cost and labor charge
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦{込|こ}み→込み：28615_komi⟧: parts included (in the price)
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧: parts are expensive
- {部品代|ぶひんだい}⟦{別途|べっと}→別途：11881_betto⟧: parts charged separately

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{工賃|こうちん}→工賃：23036_kouchin⟧: labor charge — the cost of the work itself
- {修理代|しゅうりだい}: repair cost — the total cost of a repair
- ⟦{材料費|ざいりょうひ}→材料費：11512_zairyouhi⟧: material cost — broader term covering raw materials
